reasoning_content: Now install Java 17 and set up the environment.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Install Java 17
print("Installing Java 17...")
c.exec_command("apt-get update && apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk 2>&1 | tail -10")

# Check Java
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("java -version 2>&1")
print("Java:", stdout.read().decode())

# Set environment
c.exec_command("""echo 'export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk' >> ~/.bashrc
echo 'export PATH=\\$PATH:\\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:\\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools' >> ~/.bashrc
echo 'export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64' >> ~/.bashrc""")

print("Environment set!")

# Verify SDK
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls ~/android-sdk/")
print("SDK:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
